assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 桥下空间涉及的桥梁结构、轨道保护区、绿地蓝线与文物保护条件未知，本方案不给出任何结构或具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Bridge, rail-protection, and statutory conditions are unknown; concept-level only, no structural conclusions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 本方案明确不涉及桥梁结构改造、承载与工程可行性结论，桥下使用均以轻量可逆装置与现状条件为前提。
assumptions.statement_en: No structural modification, load, or engineering feasibility conclusions; only lightweight reversible installations.

assumptions.statement_zh: 桥下空间面积与权属数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造桥下面积、活动场次或投资数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified under-viaduct area or activity figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 安全监测与空间预约均以匿名聚合为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的桥下活动宣传须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不夸大活动效果、不把设想写成已确定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated activity copy requires human review; no overstated claims.

assumptions.statement_zh: 截至提交，未完成官方商标检索与在先权利核查；「桥下智环」「UNDER·JZ」及全部标识图样按内部工作代号处理，限制外部注册与商用，直至完成在先权利检索与合法化核查。
assumptions.statement_en: No official trademark search completed at submission; all names and marks are internal working codenames restricted from external registration/use until clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 用地单一口径（8 类占比）仅按本包 provisional 几何在 EPSG:4548 聚合复算，置信等级低；官方几何发布后按同一公式复算并替换所有展示数值。
assumptions.statement_en: The single land-use caliber (8 classes) is aggregated from provisional package geometry in EPSG:4548 (low confidence); recomputed by the same formula on official geometry release.
